title: Create keys in bulk
summary: The New license drawer over the dimmed, scroll-locked Licenses list, opened by Create keys in bulk, on its Review step: 200 floating Standard keys in the batch 'Mixer bundle · Oct 2026', each limit with its source, the duration from the tier, CSV delivery, and what happens as numbered steps, with an action-named primary at the foot. What happens after Create is in licenses.bulk-keys-done.
compare: Behind: the reworked Licenses list, scroll-locked under the scrim.

Drawer: 'New license', the stepper band (Tier, Who, Limits, Delivery done; Review current), then the review card with Change on every row: Tier Standard; Who '200 floating keys' in the batch 'Mixer bundle · Oct 2026'; Limits (Devices 5, Offline days 30, Fingerprint Normal from Standard; Release tracks stable, Versions Any by default); Duration Lifetime (Standard); Delivery Download a CSV (key, license id, batch).
What happens, one line each: 'The keys show once, in a CSV.' and 'Download it before you close this.'
Phone: a bottom sheet; the stepper shows marks and the current label; the limits keep two columns.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

The New license drawer has one title (no second key icon beside it), the License rule on its top and the action-named ink primary pinned at the foot; Review rows keep xs outlined Change buttons, so source pills never touch them (admin-1-26).

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: the kit's drawer with a band, kv-rows with actions and a compact dl; the page behind is the reworked list; 0 screen spacing.

findings.issue: 30 spacing declarations, a copy of the old list's custom table, and a custom review grid with source pills on every limit.
findings.resolution: Kit only: .console.modal-open, .overlay.end.sheet, .drawer.scroll with .drawer-band and .stepper.compact, .kv-rows with .kv-action, .dl.compact with .source, .num-list.

findings.issue: The summary title repeated every row (200, floating, Standard); the info callout repeated step 2.
findings.resolution: Rows say it once; step 2 carries the download window.

findings.issue: Em-dash step separators; labels truncated on phone; repeated 'Standard' source tags.
findings.resolution: Stepper is .stepper.compact.lined (mark over label, hairline between marks) with every label visible on phone; a limit's source tag shows only when it differs from the tier (Default stays). The drawer body already scrolls above its pinned foot, so 'What happens' is never covered at rest.
